name: EleksMaker pen plotter / laser engraver GRBL revival

mentions.name: EleksMaker pen plotter / laser engraver GRBL revival
mentions.description: This project restores an old EleksMaker pen plotter / laser engraver with a replacement controller, including setting up GRBL and finding open-source driving software.
mentions.problem: The plotter's controller died a while ago, and previously available driving software was expensive, hard to use, and generally frustrating.
mentions.source_excerpt: Old eleksmaker pen plotter / laser engraver sitting around had it's controller die a while ago, finally got a new one, but will have to actually learn how to setup GRBL and find some open source software for driving
